name: Taming the Beast
summary: Grif Wildheart sends you to face a snow leopard in the second taming trial. The test reaches beyond the crag boar.

sections.title: A Lesson in Finesse
sections.body: Snow leopards prowl southeast of Kharanos. The crag boar tested your strength against hard blows. Now Grif expects you to face a swift, graceful predator on its own terms. Beneath its white coat lies dangerous strength, ready to strike.

sections.title: Mastering the Taming Rod
sections.body: With an enchanted taming rod, you face a wild snow leopard and seek to turn its hunting instincts toward partnership. Its speed, agility, and sharp reflexes test you in ways the crag boar did not. Learn to work alongside a predator that strikes swiftly from the snowy crags, and you draw closer to mastering the beasts of the wild.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This is the second trial in the dwarf hunter rite of passage. Grif Wildheart tests your skill against different beasts before teaching you to form lasting bonds with animal companions.

faq.q: Where do I find the snow leopards?
aliases: where are snow leopards dun morogh
faq.answer: Snow leopards prowl the rocky crags and snowy slopes south and east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why does Grif Wildheart want me to tame a leopard?
faq.answer: Grif Wildheart wants you to learn both strength and finesse. The crag boar relies on resilience, while the snow leopard teaches you to fight alongside a swift, agile, deadly companion.

faq.q: Do I get to keep this snow leopard permanently?
aliases: can i keep the snow leopard
faq.answer: No. The beasts you tame in these first trials are temporary partners, bound by the taming rod's magic. When Grif considers your training complete, you can permanently tame any wild beast you choose.
Grif Wildheart, the dwarf hunter trainer outside the inn in Kharanos, Dun Morogh, assigns this trial.

faq.q: What comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: After you master the snow leopard, Grif sends you to face an Ice Claw Bear in the third and final taming trial. Then he teaches you to tame and train wild beasts on your own.

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn how boars endure punishment while cats strike with speed and aggression.
As a dwarf, you share Dun Morogh's frozen peaks with snow leopards, whose stealth and hunting skill command respect.
